prose: Forbes reports, citing sources and internal documents, that TikTok quietly cut the number of advertising violations for which an advertiser could be immediately banned from 37 to 13 last fall, and that scams on the platform have exploded since.
Basis: the Forbes page could not be fetched in this pass, so this rests on the headline and feed excerpt. Read the original for detail on the internal documents.
highlights: TikTok cut immediately-bannable ad violations from 37 to 13
Change made quietly last fall, per internal documents
